sectors.trend: Broad-based exploration activity: Qld gold (Moonlight), WA gold (Great Southern), WA titanium (McLaren), NSW antimony (Hillgrove), Nevada tungsten (Viking), Brazilian phosphate (Aguia). Coal boom supports BHP.AX, BLS.AX, WDS.AX. MRG.AX cleared by ASIC.
sectors.implications: Exploration upside for small-caps; coal strength supports large-cap miners. MRG.AX de-risked. Diversified commodity exposure attractive amid oil-driven inflation.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs US pricing deal with Trump administration — volume-for-price trade. August data shows strong weight-loss drug demand. Hospital bed crisis (1,400 in Qld) pressures public health spend.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX near-term margin pressure offset by volume; long-term US market access secured. Weight-loss drug tailwind benefits CSL and pharma peers.

sectors.trend: Oil climbing on Middle East tensions; diesel shock flagged as structural. Wind farm drought being addressed by Danish entrant. Energy watchdog rejects $1bn transmission bailout. Gas reservation debate active.
sectors.implications: Positive for WDS.AX, BLS.AX, AGL.AX on oil/diesel. Transmission cost rejection pressures AGL/Origin capex. Renewables pipeline revival benefits CSP.AX, LEM.AX.

sectors.trend: Sydney house price crash described as global-scale. Bathla developer near collapse. Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes. Negative gearing debate unresolved. Renter respite emerging.
sectors.implications: Headwind for REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and builders (WBC.AX, GPT.AX). Credit contraction signals tightening lending. Renter relief may support consumer staples.

sectors.trend: Qantas strike vote threatens QAN.AX operations. Property credit crash pressures bank NIMs. Macquarie audit bid controversy. World debt spiral concerns.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX operational risk. Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face property credit headwinds but benefit from higher-for-longer rates. Macquarie (MQG.AX) governance watch.

sectors.trend: Kids clothing giant closes 29 stores; firearms retailer files Chapter 11. Dupe brands and EV uptake rising. Meta $24b settlement influenced by AU social media ban. AI contagion warning from top central banker.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under pressure. EV uptake supports battery/charging names. Meta settlement validates AU regulatory leverage. AI disruption risk is a systemic concern.

Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/defensive allocation amid per capita recession risk
defensive_moves.rationale: Domestic inflation + recession fears create uncertain RBA path; liquidity premium warranted

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower. Oil-driven energy outperformance offsets property and consumer weakness. CSL.AX volatile on US deal digestion. Qantas strike risk adds idiosyncratic volatility. RBA on hold but hawkish bias persists given home-grown inflation.
market_outlook.long_term: Per capita recession risk and property credit contraction cap upside. Commodity cycle (coal, gold, critical minerals) provides structural support for materials. Renewable energy and EV transition offer medium-term growth. AI disruption remains a tail risk. CSL US access is a multi-year positive.
